sourceLessons.title: What Are KPIs and Why Do They Matter?

checklistItems.label: Ethan wants to double his calls next month. Agree with him what he should aim for.
A customer waited four days for Ethan to reply to her email. Agree with him how to handle customer emails.
Agree with Ethan how you'll both know whether it's working.

scenarioSummary.now: You manage your company's sales team. Ethan joined your team four weeks ago, and this is his first sales job. His job is to call people who have shown interest in your company's service and get them to sign up. On his first day, your only advice was to get comfortable on the phone and make as many calls as he could. You haven't given him any other guidance since. Today is his first monthly check-in. He's keen and wants to do well. Help him plan his next month.
scenarioSummary.layers: A double the calls vs a sign-up aim with a number and a date → B "I'll try to be quicker" vs a clear reply time for customer emails → C "I'll tell you at the end of the month" vs what you'll look at and how often.
